translation: Today, the descendants of Krishnadas Maharaj have established the gadi (the guru's seat of succession) at Sardarpur. It stands as the guru-gadi for the devotees of Kantha district. Thus this Sardarpur is a sacred site. A few tulsi-kyaros (tulsi-plant memorial platforms marking a departed saint's resting place) of the gadi's descendants are also there, though they now lie neglected and deserted.
